context: M28 o1. Corwin lobby, 09:55. Odessa in a white church hat and gloves. A bedsheet banner. Carmen arrives with the operators.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Mr. Arce. Hand me my cane. If they want us out, they can watch us walk.

lines.speaker: char.carmen_arce
lines.text: Mijo! The Local came. Feld owes us. Mei-lin brought the whole floor.

lines.speaker: char.bernard_ostrow
lines.text: I've prepared a statement. Short words only. Like 'no.'

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Broadway's closed till one. Let's use it.
